release: PATCH on 6.1.0, driven by a real 119-page run. FIX: schema validation read every crawl record, not just HTML 200s. That run held 92 HTML pages and 27 redirects/errors and reported schema on 93 - so a NON-200 record carried JSON-LD, and SEO-049 is SCORED, meaning a redirect page's leftover markup could deduct points from a site whose real pages are clean. Same false-positive class as the redirect-is-absent gate in 6.1.0, one layer along; every other static check already ran over HTML 200s only and this now does too. The verdict table still lists non-200 URLs - a redirect is a real fact about the site and must not vanish because its markup is excluded from schema validation. DOCS: the in-app manual was two releases stale - it described FOUR tools and never mentioned Content & SEO at all. It now covers all five in the shipped order, adds a section on indexability written for non-technical readers (what each verdict means, why Google and Bing can differ, and the robots.txt plus noindex trap that keeps a page in search results forever), states that each tool keeps its own Settings, and answers the question everyone actually asks - does this tell me if my site is on Google - with the honest distinction between CAN be indexed and IS indexed.
